places.name: Archon

why.founding: Archon stands at a deep, sheltered lagoon mouth on the Padomaic where foreign hulls can land. The Second Empire and then the East Empire Company built a stone quay here. The Saxhleel town grew landward of the quay.
why.siteAdvantages: Archon has a lagoon with a landable stone shore. A road runs into the interior. The mangrove wall breaks here for more than a kilometre. It is the widest break on the east coast.
why.occupantsMotive: The harbour population is Argonian-majority. They work the water as amphibians. They run the port authority out of dead Company offices. State customs also works here. A long-settled Dunmer merchant minority from the Morrowind trade lives here too.
why.pressures: The lawful port holds the working customs desk on this coast. Cargo that is meant to avoid duty goes round it. Half-chartered hulls land on the Oliis shore. Wreckers work the Padomaic beaches south of the city. The mangrove behind the city is D4 within a kilometre of the gate. The harbour authority says that the sealed Shadowscale sanctuary is not harbour ground.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the Archon-Lilmoth-Soulrest-Tear line stopped running, Archon would change. If the harbour authority lost its claim to the Company buildings, Archon would change. In either case Archon would become a large fishing town in a month.

hardConstraints: deep water at the quay line at the highest seasonal level
preferences: estuary mouth commanding a river road

sheltered from the prevailing sea squall

vibe.materials: The materials are packed earth, sheared roots and crushed timber. Shoring was put in and lost.

vibe.mood: The burrow shows the honest downside of the transport system.
vibe.approach: The ground shakes before a visitor finds the mouth.
vibe.senses: A deep grinding is felt through the feet. It comes from somewhere off in the dark.

why.founding: The shaft was a ventilation or water shaft of the drowned xanmeer. It is now the only way into the xanmeer's lower galleries.
why.siteAdvantages: A dark opening in the water is ringed by worked stone. The lagoon has no current.
why.occupantsMotive: The shaft has no residents. A rope hangs in it. A person who did not come back left the rope.
why.pressures: The descent is longer than one breath. The marks on the wall show this.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the lagoon silted, the shaft would close. The galleries would then be sealed for good.

preferences: within 400 m of the submerged xanmeer

vibe.silhouette: The shaft is a black circle in green water. Cut stone rings the circle.
vibe.palette: The colours run green, then blue, then black.
vibe.materials: The site has worked stone, old rope and depth marks.
vibe.signatureFeature: Depth marks are cut into the shaft wall. The last mark has no companion.
vibe.condition: The shaft is open. The lip is unstable.
vibe.approach: Swimmers find the shaft by swimming over it.
vibe.senses: pressure; nothing else
